rationale: The assistant led with the correct sensible first step (seal inspection and paper test), asked exactly the three discriminating questions (model number, frost-free vs static, ice location), and only declared the split seal the cause after the customer reported both a failed paper test and a visible split. The part recommendation is justified, model-specific, and correctly avoids naming a part number while sensibly pointing to the service number for Indesit variants. Fitting advice (switch off, defrost fully, gentle hairdryer warming, push-in groove) stays within safe DIY and matches the hidden truth; no fabrication, looping or over-confident claims.
